text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Tracen Academy cafeteria... Here, an 
unseen battle unfolds day and night—!

text_block_list.name: Staff (Rookie)
text_block_list.text:
I've been assigned here starting today. 
It's nice to meet you...!

text_block_list.name: Staff (Veteran)
text_block_list.text:
Hmph. A rookie, huh...? Do your best to 
survive, at least...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The moment those words were spoken, a 
chime echoed throughout the deserted 
cafeteria—!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
What should I eat today...? I'm so 
hungry... Maybe I'll get a little more 
than usual... or something...

text_block_list.name: Staff (Rookie)
text_block_list.text:
(After what they said, I braced myself... 
but it turns out I'm totally fine...)

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Um... I'll have a large portion of omelet 
rice, Neapolitan pasta, and... also, 
carrot toppings, please.

text_block_list.name: Staff (Rookie)
text_block_list.text:
W-Whaaat!? You're going to eat all that by 
yourself!?

text_block_list.name: Staff (Veteran)
text_block_list.text:
If you're shocked by this, you'll never 
survive. Look, the Commander-in-Chief has 
arrived.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Haaah~... I'm totally starving~. What 
should I eat today?♪

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, the mapo tofu looks delicious, and 
the katsudon looks great too~... Alright! 
They all look delicious, so I'll take one 
of everything!

text_block_list.name: Staff (Rookie)
text_block_list.text: A-All of it!?

text_block_list.name: Staff (Veteran)
text_block_list.text:
Burn this into your memory. This is the 
true power of General Special Week.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Grrrrr...)

text_block_list.name: Staff (Rookie)
text_block_list.text: ...What was that sound just now?

text_block_list.name: Staff (Veteran)
text_block_list.text: Here it comes... Here it comesーーー!

text_block_list.name: Staff (Rookie)
text_block_list.text: Wh-what in the world showed up... !?

text_block_list.name: Staff (Veteran)
text_block_list.text: The Monster――――it's Oguri Cap!!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Mmh... How embarrassing. My stomach 
growled.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Now then, what should I eat today...

text_block_list.name: Staff (Rookie)
text_block_list.text:
Huh...? You're just wondering what to eat? 
Well, at least it's not everything on the 
menu...

text_block_list.name: Staff (Veteran)
text_block_list.text:
You don't get it... The moment she decides 
what to eat... is the signal that all its 
ingredients are about to vanish...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... I'm in the mood for a hamburg 
steak today.

text_block_list.name: Staff (Veteran)
text_block_list.text:
"Run, rookie! Ground meat, carrots, 
onions, and all the rest! Bring every last 
ingredient we need for the hamburger 
steaks!!"

text_block_list.name: Staff (Rookie)
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After a short while, the chime gently rang 
to signal the end of lunch break—

text_block_list.name: Staff (Rookie)
text_block_list.text:
*pant* *pant*... It's over, isn't it... I 
had no idea... it would be this hard...

text_block_list.name: Staff (Veteran)
text_block_list.text:
How about it, rookie...? Want me to ask 
them to change your assignment?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"The meal was delicious today as well. 
I'll be sure to come again..."

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for the meal! As expected, I 
could eat the food here every single day 
and never get tired of it!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...Phew. Thank you, as always... I truly 
appreciate it.

text_block_list.name: Staff (Rookie)
text_block_list.text:
...I'll do it! If it's for that smile, I 
can give it my all!

text_block_list.name: Staff (Veteran)
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Then stop spacing out and help prep 
for tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the battle of the unsung heroes 
protecting the smiles of the Umamusume 
would continue on...!
